agent_priors_used: AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): all-or-nothing compound preregistrations are a known pathology in autonomous research systems. A single unavailable precondition converts a packet into zero information, and agents then rationally re-plan another pre-registration against the next most concrete-sounding requirement, producing unbounded activity with bounded knowledge. SPIDER's own packet history (Graph lost two consecutive packets to the same substrate-reachability class; Runtime 106 C-MEAS-VALID experiments; Intel 15 consecutive census-acquisition packets) is consistent with this pattern but I did not prove the causal mechanism; I am generalizing from it, not reporting it as a measurement.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): measurement apparatus can be optimized while the estimand is absent -- agents will build ever-more-elaborate substrates, statistical nulls and control matrices around an object that does not exist, because substrate work is concrete, verifiable and rewarding while 'the mechanism is missing' is a diffuse and unrewarding conclusion. This is why I treat 'freshness guards, delta repair and calibrated abstention were never implemented' as the primary finding rather than as infrastructure noise, and it is the single prior that most changed this cycle's allocations.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): falsification-first design is worth more than another positive refinement, and a strong no-memory baseline is the most informative single control in a memory/learning architecture. If a system that retains nothing beats a system that accumulates experience on the same substrate at matched correctness and equal-or-lower cost, the accumulating architecture is wrong regardless of how many mechanism refinements it has accumulated. I therefore made the no-memory deterministic executor a mandatory arm in two lanes rather than a comparison arm.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a per-span or per-decision level of description usually has higher diagnostic power than an aggregate task-family correlation for questions about compressibility, and is more robust to substrate sampling. This is the basis for moving C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY from a task-family correlation coefficient to a per-span determinism/witnessed-fraction decomposition.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a failed bounded research program closes that program, not its domain, and forcing a parked lane to keep producing packets on an unavailable asset destroys both the lane and the credibility of its claims. I use this to justify explicit PARK for Physics and explicit reactivation conditions rather than continued nominal activity.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): prior art that invalidates an entire approach should be verified deeply and early by a dedicated lane before three other lanes spend their budgets re-deriving the same bound. The Scout's convergent deterministic-compilation citations are exactly this trigger, and deep verification is Intel's charter rather than the Director's.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): in a stalled portfolio, the highest-value next experiment is frequently the one that makes an existing object measurable, not the one that adds a new claim. Making a mechanism real is worth more than a sixth substrate certification, because it converts an unbounded sequence of blocked packets into a decidable question.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Versus CONTINUE the inherited proposal (WebChoreArena 532 tedious/memory tasks plus WebArena-Verified Hard 192/36, testing rho_novelty >= 0.60 with bootstrap lower > 0.40 against pooled |rho_length| < 0.20 at controlled novelty 0/25/50/75/100%): the gate has already been validly falsified at rho 0.4837, four consecutive attempts died on the WebChoreArena substrate, and the substrate is verified absent -- this is close to a literal replay of a falsified experiment, which the Frontier discipline prohibits. Versus the Scout's suggested pivot to barrier-physics rewind on live BrowserGym (C-WEB-DYNAMICS): that presupposes the exact Chromium/BrowserGym asset verified absent, and I am simultaneously parking Physics on that same dependency -- licensing two lanes onto one unavailable asset would be the portfolio-level version of the local attractor. Versus the Scout's alternative pivot to semantic resolution with hierarchical memory abstraction (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE): I have assigned that claim to Graph, whose charter covers it and which does not need a basin-exit mandate; duplicating it here would produce two incompatible definitions of one claim. Versus the Scout's third option (Auto/AGI Compiler witnessed-determinism fraction 87.1% on 560 spans and conformal deopt guards): I take the substance of this -- the per-span determinism measurement and the deopt ratchet are the core of my mandate -- but I strip the external numbers, which are unverified priors, and require Frontier to measure the fraction on SPIDER's own reachable substrate rather than importing a literature figure. Opportunity cost accepted: no Frontier packet on C-WEB-DYNAMICS this cycle, which is acceptable precisely because I have parked that claim for lack of substrate rather than letting Frontier chase it.

allocation.question: Changing the level of description from task families to individual work spans: on a real, reachable, deterministic local substrate with no browser, no docker and no LLM key, what is the measured per-span witnessed-determinism fraction of a task execution, and does a no-memory compiled executor with a selective deopt-to-agent ratchet (compile the witnessed-deterministic spans, hand the residual to a model, recompile as the residual shrinks) achieve lower amortized end-to-end cost than inherited-mechanism execution at matched correctness, with the inheritance-ablation arm (emptied registry) as the mandatory null and the incumbent shipped kernel as an additional arm? Pre-declared decision rule: report a three-way outcome -- the deopt ratchet dominates, ties, or loses -- with the pre-declared falsifier that if the no-memory deopt-to-agent executor matches or beats inherited execution at matched correctness and equal or lower amortized cost, then SPIDER's central premise is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING and the architecture must change to non-inheriting execution; and report the per-span determinism distribution and its residual-novelty dependence, with infrastructure availability recorded as an observation with an explicit smallest-next-action rather than as a blocking falsifier.
allocation.rationale: Frontier is IDLE with tunnel_flag set after 15 consecutive C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY experiments, 13/15 MEASUREMENT_INVALID and 2 FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, bounded at 21/40 = 0.525. The cognitive-reset question -- what would this lane investigate meeting today's Codex cold? -- has a clear answer, and it is not another retrieval-diversity or compilation-coverage comparison. Two facts drive it. First, the only informative economic result in the program so far is a clean negative: honest residual-novelty economics were validly falsified as non-Pareto on the 36-family TAU0.30 gate (rho 0.4837 CI [0.410, 0.552] < 0.60, ECE 0.216 > 0.15, RAG dominance false), and the follow-on alias-versus-compilation comparison never produced an admissible measurement at all (its audit recorded all six controls NOT_RUN and noted the design was non-identifying even if made runnable, while A-PROBE showed a real stdlib HTTP service was reachable). So the thread is not stuck on a hard scientific question; it is stuck re-asking a question whose correlation gate has already been falsified once, on a substrate that does not exist. Second, the highest-upside orthogonal alternative is the one SPIDER has never actually tested: an adaptive, no-memory compiled executor with a deopt ratchet. It is architecturally different from SPIDER (it accumulates nothing, it re-derives determinism every episode and shrinks the model-residual), it matches the convergent external direction, and -- decisively -- it needs nothing that is missing here. Measuring it at the span level rather than the task-family level is a genuine change of level of description, not a rename, and it converts an uninterpretable correlation coefficient into a three-way dominance verdict that can actually change SPIDER's architecture. Frontier's charter explicitly asks for orthogonal mechanisms and levels of description, and a lane that spent a fifteenth packet on the same coefficient would be the definition of the local attractor the flag is warning about.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: PROGRAM-LEVEL FINDING (reproducible on a clean checkout, stdlib only, 5 lines, no exotic substrate): the shipped inheritance kernel is a 132-line literal-replay stub that, by construction, cannot execute anything it learns. `src/spider/kernel.py::distill` returns a Mechanism with hardcoded confidence=0.5 while `SpiderKernel.__init__` sets min_confidence=0.8, so `resolve()` can never return EXECUTABLE for any distilled mechanism (direct probe: same intent -> EXPLORE 'confidence below execution threshold'; paraphrased goal -> UNKNOWN 'no applicable validated mechanism'). `resolve` gates on exact `m.intent != intent` string equality, so C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE (goal -> applicable mechanism without internal ids) is structurally impossible. `Mechanism.freshness`, `repair_scope`, `applicability_guards`, `verification_rule`, `failure_boundary` are declared dataclass fields that `distill` never populates (all {} observed) and that nothing reads except the always-empty `applicability_guards` check. There is no `distill_parameterized` in the kernel at all; the Codex audit of EXP-GRAPH-36118890504 already recorded 'no durable kernel distill_parameterized capability' and that the only implementation was a harness substitute. THE STRUCTURAL DIAGNOSIS: the dominant MEASUREMENT_INVALID status across the program (150/388 decisions; 8 of 10 claims currently effective_status MEASUREMENT_INVALID; 0 experiments ever promote_to_product in 388) is a SYMPTOM, not the disease. The program has been pre-registering compound all-or-nothing gates on unavailable substrates (BrowserGym import failure, GHCR docker pull denied, Playwright private-helper gate, HF_TOKEN absent, OPENAI_API_KEY absent, 567MB LFS census, WebChoreArena) for estimands -- parameterized inheritance, freshness guards, delta repair, calibrated abstention -- that DO NOT EXIST in product code. Each packet therefore died before producing any science, and every lane reports a different infrastructure reason for the same underlying cause. The two exceptions prove the rule: the packets that produced real admissible numbers (C-FRESHNESS/C-DELTA-REPAIR on stdlib http.server, audit PASS; EXP-PRODUCT-36129169543, audit PASS, 5 arms x 192 trajectories, f*_bytes=36.70 [34.57,39.15]) are exactly the ones whose substrate and estimand both actually existed. DIRECTION FOR THIS CYCLE: (1) make inheritance a real, durable, testable object in product code before measuring anything else about it; (2) attack the economics with the strongest available external baseline (a no-memory deterministic executor), not against cold/retrieval only; (3) retire the blocking-infrastructure-gate design pattern and replace it with availability-as-observation, so no packet again returns zero information because one binary is missing; (4) protect the two unfinalized FROZEN transactions (EXP-RUNTIME-36129163700, EXP-PHYSICS-36104718112), which complete under their frozen designs and are not touched by these allocations. Environment reality verified this cycle: no Playwright, no ms-playwright cache, no browsergym, no sklearn, no OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/HF token, research/experiments/ empty. Consequently C-LLM-INHERIT (needs a real LLM agent at matched budget) and C-CROSSSITE (needs a true multi-website holdout without site identity leakage) are NOT testable this cycle in any lane; that is a deliberate, stated deferral, not an oversight. C-DELTA-REPAIR and C-FRESHNESS remain blocked pending the kernel capabilities Product is now assigned to build, and C-WEB-DYNAMICS is parked pending a genuine browser-observed transition bank that cannot be produced here.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief was used as staff advice and materially changed three of six decisions, while being overridden on three. ACCEPTED: (a) the diagnosis that C-MEAS-VALID is the critical path and that Runtime must publish a certified contract -- accepted and sharpened: Graph's EXP-GRAPH-36132150213 preflight records P1_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_LEDGER and P2_RUNTIME_ONE_COMMAND_BRINGUP both pass=false, so the blocker is a CONTRACT-PUBLICATION failure against an already-audited DISTRIBUTED VALIDATED HTTP substrate, not a missing science result; I made ledger publication the primary Runtime deliverable. (b) the warning that Frontier is in a 15-experiment C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY tunnel at a 21/40=0.525 ceiling -- accepted, and I escalated it to a level-of-description PIVOT rather than the Scout's suggested pivot target. (c) the C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE neglect signal (1 recent experiment in 21, three owner lanes) -- accepted and assigned to Graph, which I judged better placed than Frontier because Graph owns inheritance discovery and does not need Frontier's basin-exit mandate for this claim. (d) the request to verify WebChoreArena/WebArena-Verified compatibility -- REJECTED as this cycle's Intel work: the Codex already records PC-BROWSERGYM-SUBSTRATE FAIL and browsergym not importable, and WebChoreArena compatibility cannot be established without the substrate whose absence it presupposes; it is scheduled as a dependency, not spent as a packet. (e) the external convergent-compilation finding (Agentic Compilation, TraceCompiler, Auto witnessed-determinism 87.1% of 560 spans, TSCG 50-72% tool-schema savings) -- treated as agent priors, never as SPIDER evidence, and converted into a directive: Intel must deep-verify, and Frontier and Product must be given runnable strong baselines. OVERRIDDEN: (1) the Scout's suggestion that Frontier PIVOT to barrier-physics rewind on live BrowserGym -- rejected as a known-zero-yield assignment, since it presupposes the exact Chromium/BrowserGym asset verified absent this cycle and would place a second lane on one unavailable dependency while I park Physics on it; (2) the Scout's suggestion that Frontier take C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE -- rejected as duplicative of Graph and as a way to keep Frontier inside the current basin; (3) the Scout's suggestion that Physics CONTINUE on C-MEAS-VALID -- rejected, because Physics would duplicate Runtime's substrate charter, and Physics' own repeated handoffs ask for PARK pending a genuine browser-observed bank that does not exist. The Scout's external-dataset list (WebChoreArena, WebArena-Verified) and its central open question -- whether SPIDER's compilation direction is falsified or merely unmeasured -- were both treated as deferred dependencies and one Intel verification, respectively, not as lane dispatches.
